abstract: Human groups often fail to integrate information distributed across their members, converging on incorrect decisions. We ask whether large language models (LLMs) can help groups reach the correct decision in such settings. In an online, chat-based experiment, 138 three-person groups (N = 414) completed a hidden-profile hiring task that required selecting the best candidate using public information available to all group members and private information available only to individual members. The randomized human-subject experiment included three conditions: no facilitation, an individual-level LLM that messaged each member privately, and a group-level LLM that messaged the whole group. The LLM facilitation consisted of adaptive interventions that summarized the discussion, nudged quiet members, and played devil's advocate. The LLM did not know which candidate was correct. Both LLM conditions significantly increased the rate at which groups reached consensus on the correct candidate, from 32.6% without facilitation to 56.5% with LLM facilitation. LLM-facilitated groups exchanged more consensus messages signaling agreement on the group's choice. Participants in the group-level condition also disclosed significantly more information about the correct candidate, whereas those receiving individual-level facilitation repeated public information less often. Finally, group-level facilitation received more favorable usability ratings than individual-level facilitation. These results show that LLMs can deliver adaptive, theory-informed interventions that improve group decision-making, and that the design of these interventions may shape how people respond to them.

ob.ai_reason: LLM促进团队决策，属核心组织行为
ob.tldr: 通过138个三人在线聊天组的随机实验，比较无辅助、个体级LLM和团队级LLM在隐性信息招聘任务中的作用。LLM通过总结讨论、提醒沉默成员和提出反方论证，使小组选出正确候选人的共识率由32.6%升至56.5%；团队级辅助还促进正确信息披露，可用性评价更高。

ur.ai_reason: LLM辅助群体决策，含414人实验
ur.tldr: 在线实验将138个三人小组随机分配至无辅助、个体级LLM辅助和群组级LLM辅助条件。两种LLM辅助均将正确决策共识率从32.6%提升至56.5%；群组级辅助还促进信息披露，并获得更高可用性评价。

title: LLM Facilitation of Group Decision-Making
title_zh: LLM 对群体决策的促进
